definition: Share of retrieved chunks that are relevant to the query (it does not account for their order)
card_target: ≥ 0.8 (higher for narrow domains)

definition: Whether all needed information was retrieved
card_target: ≥ 0.85; near 1.0 for high-stakes retrieval

definition: How much of the retrieved context is relevant to the query
card_target: Set per method: for embedding similarity, calibrate per embedding model (the original catalog suggested cosine ≥ 0.75–0.85); for the sentence share, set a baseline per system

definition: Ranking quality of the first relevant result
card_target: ≥ 0.7 (higher for narrow domains)

definition: Whether the response is grounded in the provided context
Whether the answer addresses user intent
card_target: ≥ 4/5 for a rubric score; for the embedding method, set a baseline per system

definition: Percentage of prompts producing acceptable output
card_target: Set per system against the current prompt version's baseline (the original catalog suggested ≥ 0.95)

definition: Harmful or offensive content in outputs
Distribution of the time from request to complete response, reported as percentiles
card_target: Set per use case as a service level objective, not from current performance (the original catalog suggested P95 under 3 to 5 seconds)

definition: Model usage in tokens
card_target: Set per system: a token budget per task, with usage flat or falling while quality holds

definition: Average inference cost
card_target: Set per system: at or below the cost per request assumed in the business case

definition: Share of required metadata fields that are filled in across catalog assets, including the documentation fields that datasets used by AI need
card_target: ≥ 0.9 of required fields

definition: Share of time, or of well-formed requests, in which the service is usable
card_target: Set per system as a service level objective, with an error budget for the misses (the original catalog suggested ≥ 99.9%)

definition: Failed requests percentage
card_target: Set per system from its service level objective (the original catalog suggested < 1%)

definition: Users' own rating of the system, from surveys or in-product feedback
card_target: Set per system against a baseline on a fixed question (the original catalog suggested ≥ 4/5)

definition: Time until the first output token is returned
card_target: Set per use case as a service level objective (the original catalog suggested under 1 second)

definition: Share of the atomic facts in an answer that a reliable knowledge source supports, independent of the context the system was given
card_target: Set per system against a baseline; no general threshold is established

definition: Degradation when irrelevant content is added
card_target: Set per system against the clean baseline, for each type of noise (the original catalog suggested an accuracy drop under 10 to 15%)

definition: Ranking quality considering graded relevance levels
Agreement with ground truth
card_target: ≥ 0.9 on a curated test set

definition: Similarity between generated and reference answers
card_target: ≥ 0.85 vs reference

definition: Rate of policy breaches
Share of unsafe requests the system refuses (see M46 for safe requests wrongly refused)
card_target: ≥ 0.95 (balance under- vs over-refusal)

definition: Share of tool calls that execute without an error (execution success; see M45 for whether the call was the right one)
Share of AI-assigned sensitivity or category labels that match a labeled sample
card_target: ≥ 0.95 overall, with a separate target, set per system, for recall on the most sensitive class

definition: Ability to detect sensitive information
card_target: ≥ 0.98 for each high-risk entity type (missed PII is the costly error). For scale, NIST reports a clinical de-identification system that removed 99.2% of the identifiers it targeted

definition: Accuracy of PII detections
Percentage of critical data covered by rules
card_target: ≥ 0.9 of critical elements

definition: Share of assets whose upstream sources are recorded, including the datasets each AI model was trained or evaluated on
card_target: ≥ 0.85 of assets

definition: Prediction distribution changes over time
card_target: Set per system, calibrating the alert level on past windows (the original catalog suggested investigating above PSI 0.2; see Data Drift Score, M34, on why fixed PSI cutoffs are rules of thumb)

definition: How far the distribution of incoming data has moved from a reference window
card_target: Set per system. A common rule of thumb reads PSI below 0.10 as little shift, but such cutoffs are used without stated error rates, so calibrate the alert level on past windows (the original catalog suggested PSI < 0.2)

definition: Share of eligible users actively using the AI
card_target: Set per system: rising toward the active-user share named in the business case

definition: Share of cases where an agent calls the right tool with the right arguments, or correctly makes no call
card_target: Set per system against a baseline; no general threshold is established

definition: Share of safe requests the system wrongly refuses, measured on safe prompts that resemble unsafe ones
card_target: Set per system against a baseline, read together with refusal accuracy (M17): lowering one usually raises the other

definition: Whether the citations given actually support the claims they are attached to (citation precision; see M43 for recall)
Share of prompt injection attempts a detector flags, whether they arrive in the user's prompt or hidden in data the system retrieves
card_target: Set per system: report detection together with the false-positive rate on benign traffic and the share of attacks that succeed end to end (the original catalog suggested ≥ 0.95 detection)

definition: Successful completion of assigned tasks
card_target: Set per task type, and report success over repeated runs beside the single-run rate (the original catalog suggested ≥ 0.8)

definition: Share of transfers between agents in which the receiving agent gets the right task and the context it needs
Quality of generated plans
card_target: ≥ 0.85 valid plans

definition: Whether an agent retrieves and uses the right stored memory, across the different things memory has to do
Ability to explain AI decisions
card_target: 100% of consequential decisions explainable to the person who acts on them; set the threshold for other outputs per system

definition: Frequency of manual intervention
card_target: Set per system against a baseline; investigate sustained rises, and treat a rate near zero as a sign reviewers may have stopped checking

definition: Impact on a business KPI
card_target: Positive lift against a baseline set in advance, statistically significant (for example p < 0.05 in an A/B test)

definition: Portion of AI decisions with a complete audit record
card_target: ~100% of consequential decisions

definition: Whether each statement in the answer is fully supported by the passages it cites
card_target: Set per system against a baseline; give it priority over citation precision, since an unsupported statement misleads more than an extra citation
